title: Issue tickets from the booking page
caption: ota/admin/src/app/(console)/bookings/[bookingId]/actions.ts issueTickets → ota/backend/src/console/console-booking-actions.service.ts issue. The key is rendered with the page; a double submit replays the same request.

steps.label: Issue tickets: reason, e-mail box, (airline card: CASH/ACCOUNT, allowUnpaid)
steps.note: Hidden: bookingId, version (If-Match), actionKey = crypto.randomUUID() of this render

steps.label: requireStaff("bookings:issue") (refresh if < 60 s); Zod; allowUnpaid only owner/admin
POST /v1/console/bookings/{id}/issuance — If-Match: version, Idempotency-Key: actionKey, capturePayment: true
idempotency_keys (processing); claim ticketing_status = in_progress
steps.note: 412 stale version, 409 ALREADY_ISSUED / BOOKING_NOT_MODIFIABLE (ticketing_in_progress, cancellation_pending), 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED

steps.label: booking_tickets, bookings ticketed/issued, payments captured, booking_events, notifications booking.ticketed, staff_actions payment.capture + booking.issue
revalidatePath(/bookings/{id}) → new render, new keys
steps.note: Final 4xx stored under the key → state carries nextActionKey; 412/429/5xx/timeout → same key; 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED → same key + reload message
